summary:
開拓重工EPS超預期9.5%，季度營收創高顯示基建與資源需求支撑穩固。
• EPS 5.16美元，超出預期4.71美元，超預期幅度9.51%
• 營收191.3億美元，為本批單季最高，反映需求基礎扎實
• 獲利穩定超預期，顯示成本與定價管理得宜
• 工程機械、能源與運輸多元終端市場分散風險
ai_view:
訊號正面：近9.5%的EPS超預期與本批最高的單季營收，顯示開拓重工終端需求穩健、獲利品質佳。短期對股價偏多，但營收年增率未揭露，須結合後續季度判斷成長持續性。中期觀察基建與能源資本支出循環是否延續。追蹤指標：積壓訂單、各部門營收與利潤率、經銷商庫存、自由現金流與回購節奏。

需留意：營收年增率未揭露，無法直接判斷成長趨勢方向；高本益比下景氣循環下行風險須留意；全球製造業PMI與大宗商品波動直接影響訂單

summary_en:
Caterpillar beat EPS by 9.5% with the batch's highest quarterly revenue, underpinned by solid demand.
• EPS of $5.16 beat the $4.71 estimate by 9.51%
• Revenue of $19.13B, the highest single-quarter figure in this batch, signals a solid demand base
• A steady earnings beat reflects sound cost and pricing management
• Diversified end markets across construction, energy and transportation spread risk

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a ~9.5% EPS beat alongside the batch's highest quarterly revenue points to steady end demand and good earnings quality. Near-term bullish for the stock, though with YoY undisclosed, growth durability needs confirmation in coming quarters. Mid-term, watch whether the infrastructure and energy capex cycle persists. Track: backlog, segment revenue and margins, dealer inventory, free cash flow and buyback pace.

Watch：Revenue YoY not disclosed, obscuring the growth trajectory; Cyclical downside risk warrants caution given the elevated multiple; Global manufacturing PMI and commodity swings directly affect orders
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期9.51%，營收191.3億美元為本批最高（年增率未揭露）。
